query:
SELECT NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM users u
                WHERE u.id = $1
                  AND u.deleted_at IS NULL
                  AND NOT EXISTS (
                      SELECT 1 FROM user_bans ub
                      WHERE ub.user_id = u.id
                        AND ub.revoked_at IS NULL
                        AND (ub.ends_at IS NULL OR ub.ends_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
                  )
            ) AS "orphaned!"
